source_dispute.context: line 4: יִתְפָּאֵר בִּי כִּי חָפֵץ בִּי. וְהוּא יִהְיֶה לִי לַעֲטֶֽרֶת צְבִי:
source_dispute.question: Is the vowel under the א a tsere or a patah? In the detail image the mark looks like one horizontal stroke. The tsere in חָפֵץ on the same line shows as two separate dots, and so does the one in לְהִתְפָּאֵר (line 14). Both drafts have tsere. The image does not settle it.
Is the small mark next to the qamats under the י a meteg? Neither draft has one. At this resolution I cannot tell it apart from the qamats or from a print speck.

source_dispute.context: line 21: יֶֽעֱרַב נָא שִׂיחִי עָלֶֽיךָ. כִּי נַפְשִׁי תַעֲרוֹג אֵלֶֽיךָ:
source_dispute.question: Is there a meteg next to the segol under the י? The drafts disagree: the primary has none and the comparison has one. The marks under the י and ע run together in the image.
